title: House Calls (TV series)
lead_cast: Wayne RogersLynn Redgrave (1979–81)Sharon Gless (1982)David WayneRay Buktenica
premise_summary: House Calls is an American sitcom that lasted three seasons and 57 episodes, from December 17, 1979, to September 6, 1982, on CBS television, produced by Universal Television and based upon the 1978 feature film of the same name.
